claim: Someone shared a message saying Lassa fever has already killed more than 250 people in Nigeria this year and that it has reached more than twenty states.
normalizedClaim: Lassa fever has killed more than 250 people in Nigeria in 2026 and has been confirmed in more than twenty states.
explanation: The NCDC's Lassa fever situation report for epi week 34 of 2026 states that 253 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with a case fatality rate of 24.0%, and that 24 states have recorded at least one confirmed case across 118 Local Government Areas. Both parts of the claim match what that report says. The figures are cumulative for 2026 up to 23 August, so they will have moved since.
simpleExplanation: Nigeria's disease control centre reported 253 Lassa fever deaths across 24 states in 2026, up to late August. The claim matches that report.
unknowns: How many deaths have been reported since 23 August 2026, the last week this report covers.
Whether the message was describing this year or an earlier outbreak.
action: Check the NCDC situation reports page for the most recent week before repeating the figures.

pcm.explanation: NCDC — na dem be di government body wey dey track disease for Nigeria — put am for dia Lassa fever report for week 34 of 2026 say 253 people don die, and say na 24.0% of confirmed cases dey die. Dem talk say 24 states don get at least one confirmed case, across 118 local government areas. So wetin di message talk gree with wetin di report talk. But note say dis figures na cumulative till 23 August 2026, so e fit don change since den.
pcm.simpleExplanation: Di claim correct. NCDC report say 253 people don die from Lassa fever for 24 states for 2026, as at late August.
unknowns: How many deaths don happen since 23 August 2026, wey be di last week wey dis report cover.
Whether di message dey talk about dis year or one outbreak wey happen before.
pcm.action: Check NCDC situation reports page make you see di latest week before you share di numbers.

fr.explanation: Le NCDC, l'agence nigériane de contrôle des maladies, indique dans son rapport de situation sur la fièvre de Lassa pour la semaine 34 de 2026 que 253 décès ont été enregistrés, soit un taux de létalité de 24,0 %, et que 24 États ont recensé au moins un cas confirmé dans 118 zones de gouvernement local. Les deux éléments de l'affirmation correspondent à ce rapport. Ces chiffres sont cumulés jusqu'au 23 août 2026 et ont donc pu évoluer depuis.
fr.simpleExplanation: L'affirmation correspond au rapport. Le NCDC a recensé 253 décès dus à la fièvre de Lassa dans 24 États en 2026, à fin août.
unknowns: Le nombre de décès survenus depuis le 23 août 2026, dernière semaine couverte par ce rapport.
Si le message parlait de cette année ou d'une épidémie antérieure.
fr.action: Consultez la page des rapports de situation du NCDC pour la semaine la plus récente avant de reprendre ces chiffres.

claim: A voice note is going round saying the health authorities have confirmed a herbal mixture cures Lassa fever and that nobody needs to go to hospital for it any more.
normalizedClaim: Nigerian health authorities have confirmed that a herbal mixture cures Lassa fever, so hospital treatment is no longer necessary.
explanation: The NCDC's own recommendation in its Lassa fever situation report for epi week 34 of 2026 tells healthcare workers to maintain high suspicion for Lassa fever and to initiate timely referral and treatment. That is the opposite of saying hospital care is unnecessary. The same report records a case fatality rate of 24.0% for 2026, and names late presentation of cases as a reason that rate is high. Nothing in the report mentions a herbal cure.
simpleExplanation: The NCDC tells health workers to refer and treat Lassa fever cases promptly. It does not describe any herbal cure, and delay is one reason the death rate is high.
unknowns: Which group or person the voice note was attributed to.
Whether the message referred to a specific product being sold.
action: Do not share the voice note, and contact the NCDC on its toll-free line 6232 to confirm anything about Lassa fever treatment.

pcm.explanation: Na di opposite of wetin NCDC dem talk. For dia Lassa fever report for week 34 of 2026, NCDC tell health workers say make dem no rest for suspicion, make dem refer patient quick and treat dem quick. Na di opposite of say person no need hospital. Di same report show say 24.0% of confirmed cases die dis year, and dem talk say one reason why di number high na because people dey come hospital late. Nothing for di report talk about any herbal cure.
pcm.simpleExplanation: NCDC dey tell health workers make dem treat Lassa fever patient quick. Dem no talk about any herbal cure, and person wey delay dey more likely to die.
unknowns: Who dem say talk di thing for di voice note.
Whether di message dey talk about one particular product wey dem dey sell.
pcm.action: No share di voice note, and call NCDC for dia toll-free line 6232 make dem confirm anything about Lassa fever treatment.

fr.explanation: C'est l'inverse de ce que dit le NCDC. Dans son rapport de situation sur la fièvre de Lassa pour la semaine 34 de 2026, l'agence demande aux soignants de maintenir un indice de suspicion élevé et d'orienter puis traiter les cas rapidement — exactement le contraire de l'idée que l'hôpital serait inutile. Le même rapport fait état d'un taux de létalité de 24,0 % pour 2026 et cite la présentation tardive des cas parmi les raisons de ce niveau élevé. Rien dans le rapport ne mentionne un remède à base de plantes.
fr.simpleExplanation: Le NCDC demande aux soignants de traiter rapidement les cas de fièvre de Lassa. Il ne mentionne aucun remède à base de plantes, et le retard de prise en charge augmente la mortalité.
unknowns: À qui le message vocal attribue cette déclaration.
Si le message faisait référence à un produit précis mis en vente.
fr.action: Ne partagez pas ce message vocal et contactez le NCDC au numéro gratuit 6232 pour vérifier toute information sur le traitement de la fièvre de Lassa.
